title: Mediterranean Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with mediterranean flavors, perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Cut the bread into small pieces and toast until crispy.
Crush the olives and mix with feta cheese.
Cut the wrap in half lengthwise.
Spread the olive and feta mixture on the wrap.
Add the toasted bread pieces on top.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
